title: 第674章 我死不死无所谓重要的是岛国死第673章 什么乱七八糟的东西啊
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 这些权柄，单独出现，耶洛基辻都没有任何的奇观，但是全部都汇聚到一起了。
这就是耶洛基辻最不能理解的地方。
咋了？你特么永恒之地的私生子啊？
这么的权柄，要逆天啊？
耶洛基辻可不觉得这些权柄能够汇聚到一个生灵的身上，这特么不是扯淡吗？
“应该是多尊集合在一起，凝聚出来的，只有这样我才能看不到，同时也是为什么会出现这么多权柄气息的缘故。”耶洛基辻不由的想到，眼中带着一丝凝重。
越是聪明的人，想的也就越多，也越容易自己脑补，祂的实力，祂的位格。
正常来讲，绝对不会出现，这种将所有逆天的权柄都汇聚一身的存在诞生。
但是偏偏这个时代属于不正常的时代。
耶洛基辻也没有想过会有这样的存在，命运，原罪，时空，灾厄，毁灭等等。
这些权柄哪一个不是逆天的存在，但是汇聚在一个生灵身上。
你别说耶洛基辻不信，换做任何一个禁忌的存在都不会相信有这样的圣灵。
你特么开挂也不带这么玩的吧。
“原罪，命运，时空，灾厄，毁灭，终焉，恶！！！新出现的势力吗？还是说这个时代崛起的，亦或者说在古老的未知时代呢？这可不是一个好消息啊。”耶洛基辻不由的想到。
这种存在的出现，对于祂来说不是什么好消息，不过也不是什么坏消息。
“算了，继续按照计划进行吧，如果祂们还在这个世界的话，早晚会出现的，不影响。”耶洛基辻不由的去想道。
祂一尊半步创世级别的存在，能让祂忌惮的东西现在已经不多了，最起码永恒之地，目前让祂忌惮的地方也只有帝国。
因为那里真的有创世，祂去的话，真的会被摁死在那里的。
毕竟帝国出了名的下手黑，而且心眼小，报复心极强，能吃亏，但是吃亏之后会一直记着。
等到有能力在彻底的报复回来。
这点就是帝国的专属被动。
这也是为什么耶洛基辻不敢去帝国的原因，因为帝国真的有创世级别的存在。
祂去的话，帝国肯定会直接弄死祂的想都不用想。
毕竟祂可是策反了一尊帝国的禁忌，战线的事情，也有祂的谋划，帝国还正好没机会找到祂呢？
祂去不就是自投罗网吗？
“不过白头鹰也该乱起来了。”耶洛基辻眸光幻灭之间，无数的算计浮现了出来。
现在的白头鹰是烂，不是乱。
烂也只是腐烂，一时半会不会死，甚至还能够回光返照。
你还别说，现在的白头鹰气运还真的增强了，就特么的离谱，但是这也正常。
和亚空间，恶魔，虫子合作，白头鹰的气运能不增强吗，但是这种增强是有限的。
烂归烂，但是白头鹰好歹还是稳住了，这不是耶洛基辻想要看到的。
要乱，只有这样白头鹰才会慢慢的削弱下去。
随着耶洛基辻开始在白头鹰搞事情。
但是白头鹰没有任何的察觉，毕竟现在的白头鹰也不是全盛时期了，现在的白头鹰气运之兽，就是一尊禁忌的存在。
想要察觉到耶洛基辻，那是不可能的事情。
苏业的主领地之中。
苏业摸着下巴躺在莉莉丝的怀里，明天去岛国，说实话苏业去的目的只有一个，搞事情，搞事情，还特么的是搞事情。
content_en:
These powers appear alone, and there are no wonders in Elokitsuji, but they all come together.
This is what Irokitsuji cannot understand the most.
What's wrong? Are you the bastard son of the eternal land?
Such authority, does it defy heaven?
Elokitsuji doesn't think that these powers can be gathered into a living being. Isn't this nonsense?
"It should be the result of many statues gathered together and condensed. Only in this way can I not see it. It is also why there are so many auras of authority." Yeroki Tsuji couldn't help but think about it, with a hint of solemnity in his eyes.
The smarter a person is, the more he thinks, and the easier it is for him to figure out his strength and his personality.
Normally, this kind of existence that brings together all the powers that defy heaven would never appear.
But this era is an abnormal era.
Yerokitsuji never thought that there would be such an existence, such as fate, original sin, time and space, disaster, destruction, etc.
None of these powers are heaven-defying, but they are gathered in one living being.
Don't tell me that Elokitsuji doesn't believe it. No taboo existence would believe in the existence of such a Holy Spirit.
Why don't you cheat like this?
"Original sin, destiny, time and space, disaster, destruction, finality, evil!!! Is it a new force? Or is it rising in this era, or in an ancient unknown era? This is not good news." Yerokitsuji couldn't help but think.
The emergence of this kind of existence is not good news for Him, but it is not bad news either.
"Forget it, let's continue according to the plan. If they are still in this world, they will appear sooner or later. It won't affect them." Yeroki Tsuji couldn't help but think.
He is a half-step creation-level existence, and there are not many things that can make him fearful. At least the eternal land, the only place that makes him fearful at present is the empire.
Because there really was creation there, and if He went there, he would really be killed there.
After all, the Empire is famous for being cunning, petty-minded, and extremely vindictive. It can suffer losses, but it will always be remembered after the losses.
Wait until you are able to come back with complete revenge.
This is the exclusive passive of the Empire.
This is also the reason why Yellokitsuji dare not go to the Empire, because the Empire really has a creation-level existence.
If he goes, the empire will definitely kill him without even thinking about it.
After all, he had rebelled against an empire's taboo, and he had planned the battle front. Why didn't the empire have a chance to find him?
Didn’t He just fall into a trap by going?
"But it's time for the bald eagle to get into trouble." As Yerokutsuji's eyes dimmed, countless schemes emerged.
The current bald eagle is rotten, not chaotic.
Rotten is just rot, it will not die for a while, and it can even come back to life.
Don't tell me, the bald eagle's luck has really improved now. It's so outrageous, but it's normal.
By cooperating with subspace, demons, and bugs, can the bald eagle's luck not be enhanced? However, this enhancement is limited.
Death will come to an end, but the Bald Eagle is still holding on. This is not what Elokitsuji wants to see.
If there is chaos, only in this way will the bald eagle slowly weaken.
As Yellokitsuji begins to stir things up in Bald Eagle.
But the bald eagle didn't notice anything. After all, the current bald eagle is no longer in its heyday. The current bald eagle, the beast of luck, is a taboo existence.
It is impossible to detect Yerokitsuji.
.............
In Su ye's main territory.
Su ye touched his chin and lay in Lilith's arms. He was going to the island country tomorrow. To be honest, Su ye had only one purpose for going there, to make trouble, to make trouble, to make trouble.
title_en: Chapter 674: It doesn’t matter whether I die or not. What matters is that the island country dies. Chapter 673: What a mess.
